component.name: Signal Chain
component.summary: Real-time patch editor and preset library manager for guitar and bass multi-effects

description.p: Signal Chain is a cross-platform patch editor and preset manager designed for guitar and bass multi-effects processors, including Zoom MS Plus pedals (MS-50G+, MS-60B+, MS-70CDR+, MS-200+) and Line 6 Bass Pod Pro rack units.

ul.li: Real-time bidirectional parameter editing and hardware footswitch synchronization.
Intuitive drag-and-drop pedalboard signal chain reordering, effect insertion, and removal.
Comprehensive patch library management with local preset storage, import, and export.
Hardware patch memory bank browsing and one-click slot management.
Direct low-latency ALSA MIDI transport support on Linux.

description.p: Hardware-accurate effect categorization, Zoom USB-MIDI onboard effect discovery, custom .ZD2 support, missing-effect safety guards, and in-app diagnostics.

ul.li: Hardware-accurate 11-category MS-60B+ grouping and dynamic per-device effect palettes
Read-only Zoom USB-MIDI onboard effect discovery (FLST_SEQ.ZT2) with Rescan Pedal
Pure-Dart .ZD2 parser, offline Custom Effects manager, and 4-tier provenance badges
Missing-effect warnings and write/restore safety guards preserving MS+ R-Out routing
Offline device switching, clean New patch tagging, and About & Diagnostics Log dialog

description.p: Add unsaved-changes protection on app close and patch switching, and Zoom MS+ configurable Right-Output (R-Out) tap routing in the signal chain.
Configure persistent Android release signing for in-place APK upgrades, add inline tempo entry, and polish desktop scrolling and filters.
Add Zoom B1X FOUR / B1 FOUR protocol and catalog support, Landscape Stage Mode dashboard, hardware tuner toggle, drag-and-drop Bank Manager, and Windows WinMM MIDI transport.
Initial release of Signal Chain Flutter edition for Linux.
